note: Thresholds are starting defaults, not benchmarks. readiness-setup asks the leader to confirm or tune them, and kpi-pulse records every change in the assumption register.

kpis.name: Medicaid share of visits
kpis.meaning: Medicaid falling while self-pay rises is the signature of coverage churn, not lost patients.

kpis.name: Self-pay share of visits
kpis.meaning: Former Medicaid and exchange patients arriving uninsured.

kpis.name: Coverage-related denial rate
kpis.formula: Claims denied with CARC 26, 27 or 31 / claims submitted
kpis.meaning: Eligibility checked too early, too rarely or not at all.

kpis.name: Point-of-service collection rate
kpis.formula: Collected at service / patient responsibility due at service
kpis.meaning: Balances that leave the building unpaid become bad debt at a much higher rate.

kpis.name: Bad debt plus charity, % of gross revenue
kpis.meaning: The lagging confirmation of churn and collection gaps.

kpis.name: Days in A/R
kpis.formula: Total A/R / average daily net revenue (trailing 90 days)

kpis.name: Level 4 and 5 share of established E/M visits
kpis.meaning: A jump after an AI documentation rollout is what payers look for. It may be legitimate; it must be explainable.

kpis.name: Contracts inside their notice window without a prep file
kpis.formula: Count of contracts where today >= prep_start and prep_status != done

kpis.name: Cash-critical vendors without a tested backup
kpis.formula: Count where cash_critical = yes and last_tested is empty or older than 12 months
kpis.meaning: One outage away from a cash stoppage.

kpis.name: Agency and locum share of labor cost
kpis.formula: Agency + locum spend / total labor cost
kpis.meaning: Shortages showing up as premium labor.
